description: Bitcoin and macro market briefings for AI agents: trend signals, regimes, liquidity and ETF flows.
rules: Call `list_briefings` first to read the live catalogue, then `get_context` with one of the ids it returned. Do not hard code a briefing id or a catalogue size.
`list_briefings`, `list_metrics` and `get_health` need no API key. `get_context` and `get_metric` need one.
Send the key as the header `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, or as `X-API-Key: <key>`. Never put a key in a URL.
An agent with no key can get a free one from inside the session: call `request_access`, show the `approve_url` to a person, then poll `check_access` until it returns the key.
Ask for `markdown` by default. Ask for `json` only when the fields are needed for a computation.
A briefing describes market conditions. It is not a forecast and not investment advice.
